description: Chapter boundary agreement for auto-chapters (@vid2context/chapters). Each item is a VideoContext recorded by another package's tests, whose video already has chapters on YouTube: creator chapters (timestamps the creator wrote in the description) or YouTube's machine-generated key moments. The suite hides those chapters and the description, proposes chapters from the transcript alone, and scores the starts against the hidden ones.

items.title: Grant Sanderson: Math, Manim, Neural Networks & Teaching with 3Blue1Brown | Lex Fridman Podcast #118
items.why: Two-hour conversation with 20 creator chapters written in the description: the only human-made reference in the set, and a long video where topics drift gradually instead of switching.
items.license: Standard YouTube license. The transcript is our own whisper.cpp output, recorded for the dedupe tests; used here only to score chapter boundaries.

items.title: Richard Feynman is misunderstood | Grant Sanderson and Lex Fridman
items.why: Short clip (under 5 minutes) with 6 key moments, several under a minute apart: tests how the chapter rules (60 s minimum, one chapter per 3 to 8 minutes) limit recall on short videos.
items.license: Standard YouTube license. Transcript is our own whisper.cpp output recorded for the dedupe tests; used only for scoring.

items.title: G-Wagon Mechanic Reveals The Truth: Are They Ridiculously Expensive To Maintain?
items.why: 14-minute single-speaker shop talk with 8 key moments and dense technical vocabulary (services, gearbox, brakes), where topic shifts are marked by vocabulary changes.
items.license: Standard YouTube license. Transcript is our own whisper.cpp output recorded for the insights tests (contact details in the description redacted); used only for scoring.

items.title: What to Look For When Buying a Used G-Wagon (Rust, Known Issues, Engine & More)
items.why: 30-minute walk-around inspection with only 4 key moments: long sections, so it tests precision when the segmenter proposes more chapters than the reference has.
items.license: Standard YouTube license. Transcript is our own whisper.cpp output recorded for the insights tests (contact details in the description redacted); used only for scoring.
